script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

EXT. LOS ANGELES STREETS - NIGHT

CAROLINE, 30s, ambitious and driven, stands on a street corner. She looks up at the stars, her heart heavy with dreams.

INT. CAROLINE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Caroline sits at her desk, staring at a blank page on her laptop. She bites her lip, frustration mounting. A phone call breaks the silence.

CAROLINE (into phone)
Hello?

NARRATOR (V.O.) (voiceover)
This is Michael. We met at the networking event last week. I was really impressed with your ideas.

Caroline's face lights up.

CAROLINE
(excited)
Hi, Michael! Yes, I'm still very passionate about my screenplay. How did you get my number?

MICHAEL (V.O.)
I collected business cards from everyone there. I saw potential in yours and wanted to discuss it further.

Caroline's heart races. This could be her big break.

EXT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Caroline meets Michael in a local coffee shop. They discuss her screenplay idea over steaming lattes. Michael offers his assistance, and they exchange numbers.

INT. CAROLINE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Caroline types away at her laptop, inspired by Michael's encouragement. She makes great progress on her screenplay, but the deadline for a major film festival is quickly approaching.

INT. CAROLINE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Caroline's phone rings. It's Michael.

MICHAEL (V.O.)
Caroline, I've read your screenplay. It's brilliant! But I think it needs some fine-tuning before we submit it to the festival.

Caroline's heart sinks. She's run out of time.

CAROLINE
(frustrated)
I don't have the luxury of time, Michael! The deadline is in two days!

MICHAEL (V.O.)
Well, I have an idea. Why don't we collaborate on it? We can work together to make it perfect.

Caroline hesitates, but her ambition wins out.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Caroline and Michael work late into the night, collaborating on the final touches of the screenplay. They make a great team, each bringing their unique perspective and creativity to the project.

INT. FILM FESTIVAL - DAY

Caroline and Michael stand in the audience, watching as their screenplay comes to life on the big screen. The crowd applauds, and they hug, tears of joy in their eyes.

CAROLINE
(whispering)
We did it.

FADE OUT.

---

This modern drama screenplay, titled "A Star is Born Again," explores the themes of ambition and collaboration. It follows the journey of a driven young woman named Caroline as she works to bring her screenplay to life with the help of a new friend and collaborator, Michael. Despite the challenges and time constraints, their combined efforts lead to success at a major film festival. This script adheres to the specified constraints and requirements, with no guns, violence, copyrighted characters, and a realistic pacing.
